protocol.policy: model candidates only; no information probes; no LB-derived coefficients

selection_policy.cohort: No candidate is grandfathered. Register each mechanism-based card, immutable artifact hash, and passing-invariant result before its first score. Historical calibration candidates and probes are excluded.
selection_policy.candidate_A: Lowest successful public RMSE among eligible frozen-cohort model candidates; scores within the pairwise sampling guard are tied and use the predeclared simplicity/adjustment-count/candidate-ID tie-break.
selection_policy.candidate_B: Deterministic 50% shrink of A's composite predictions toward A's own provided-feature prediction mean within each official region; no target means, leaderboard results, or cell adjustments.
selection_policy.predicted_vs_actual_threshold: The former 1e-3 target-error rule is superseded: target labels are unavailable and probing is forbidden; local correctness/reproducibility invariants are required instead.

noise_estimate.per_cell_formula: SE_cell(MSE) approximately sd_cell/sqrt(0.30*n_cell); sd_cell is the standard deviation of per-tract squared-error contributions and is not observable without labels
noise_estimate.planning_assumption: independent approximately normal residuals; SE(RMSE) approximately RMSE/sqrt(2*n)
noise_estimate.historical_scale_candidate_note: P4 is an LB-calibrated historical benchmark used only to illustrate score sampling noise; it is not eligible for this protocol or a new model parameter
noise_estimate.pairwise_guard_rule: SE_public(candidate_1)+SE_public(candidate_2); a smaller public RMSE difference is a tie, not a selection reason

dates_with_upload_budget.purpose: two final candidate uploads by 12:00Z; reserved

pending_fields: A and B candidate IDs, artifact paths, SHA-256 hashes, successful submission IDs, and public RMSEs after actual successful scoring
candidate-specific mechanism-based rationale and local invariant report
operator_acknowledgement: requested in lane closeout; not yet recorded
